description: Update a system record (write — editor+ role), including its boundary and recovery record. All fields are optional; only provided fields are applied.

catalog_template_id.description: New system-catalog template ID link — obtain from scf_list_system_catalog

criticality.description: Business criticality — one of: low, medium, high, critical; null clears

data_classification.description: Highest classification of data held — one of: public, internal, confidential, restricted; null clears

hosting_location.description: Where the system runs; null clears

in_scope.description: Assessment boundary: true (inside), false (outside), or null to mark it undecided

rpo_hours.description: Recovery point objective in hours (≥ 0); null clears

rto_hours.description: Recovery time objective in hours (≥ 0); null clears

system_id.description: System UUID to update — obtain from scf_list_systems

system_type.description: New system classification — one of: cloud_provider, identity_provider, ticketing, logging, security_tool, code_repository, document_management, endpoint_management, vulnerability_management, email_security, security_awareness, password_manager, communication, hr_system, custom

vendor.description: New legacy free-text vendor name (prefer vendor_id)

vendor_id.description: New structural vendor link (UUID, same org) — obtain from scf_list_vendors

name: scf_update_system
